methodology.source_boundary: Current committed Oblivion source and RUN-030 target rows only.
methodology.credit_boundary: Source presence does not establish runtime behavior, executed tests, benchmark mapping, or completion.

results.actor_action: Authenticated actor with clinical.observations.record; selected typed records additionally require their exact record action; Client view is separately authorized.
results.site_privacy: Pickers and registers are approved-Site scoped; stored Site snapshot must be null-compatible or equal canonical Client Site; a supplied protocol schedule is owner/type/client/pending scoped.
results.direct_object: Foreign Client, filters, or schedule are explicitly denied 403; source tests expect forbidden and no write, not concealed 404.
results.states_effects: Typed validation creates one observation with recorder/time/Site, NEWS2/flag/protocol provenance, timeline, and optional schedule completion/signal/event inside a three-attempt transaction.
results.audit_provenance: AuditableChanges and correction-provenance columns exist; no observation amendment/review command was found in the canonical path.
results.concurrency_idempotency: Protocol owner then schedule lock order serializes one pending-schedule completion; ordinary recording has no general request key or same-result replay contract.
strengths: Schedule lock ordering for the bounded protocol path.
gaps: Direct-object concealment is absent; current denial is 403.
General replay/idempotency and exactly-once dispatch are not established.
Amendment or stateful review lifecycle is not established.
Tests are source locators and were not executed.

results.actor_action: clinical.events.record plus Client view; review, follow-up, and escalation use separate clinical.events.review or clinical.events.escalate actions.
results.site_privacy: Record rejects Client/Shift Site mismatch and snapshots canonical Site; registers, pickers, and record-integrity checks are approved-Site scoped.
results.direct_object: Foreign direct record actions are explicit 403; source tests expect forbidden and no write, not concealed 404.
results.states_effects: Create starts open and records reporter/type/severity/time/immediate action/follow-up/provenance, timeline, and optional linked H&S path in a three-attempt transaction; signal/domain dispatch occurs after the transaction; review/follow-up/escalation are separate.
results.audit_provenance: Core record and timeline provenance exist; review timestamps/signs and escalation emits signal/timeline.
results.concurrency_idempotency: No create idempotency key, create row lock, or same-result replay; review has no lock/transaction/state guard; attachment persistence occurs after the core service transaction.
strengths: Site snapshot integrity and immediate-action guard.
gaps: Attachment/core atomicity and post-commit exactly-once dispatch are not established.
Review does not advance state and lacks lock/state guard.
Direct-object concealment is absent.
Tests were not executed.

results.actor_action: Readers require hr.employees.viewAny; mutations require hr.employees.manage; financial fields have a separate gate.
results.site_privacy: Canonical current/onboarding/historical query plus every primary and secondary assigned Site must be accessible unless explicit HR all-Sites authority applies.
results.direct_object: Scoped visible lookups and mutation checks conceal inaccessible records as 404; test source distinguishes foreign/missing 404 and explicit global positives.
results.states_effects: Create/link/update; active and inactive transitions; rehire requires inactive and appends employment history while resetting dates and restoring login/RBAC; invite resend requires inactive.
results.audit_provenance: Employee intake uses atomic AuditLogger::logOrFail; profile-version relationship/table exists but no writer was found; rehire after-commit audit and side effects are best effort.
results.concurrency_idempotency: Three-attempt intake transaction uses hashed normalized-email row mutex and fixed lock graph; no request-key same-result replay; resend can repeat.
strengths: Fixed intake lock order and audit provenance.
gaps: Seven distinct actions span multiple owners and side-effect boundaries.
No request-key same-result replay.
Longitudinal profile version history is not established.
Runtime was not proved.

results.actor_action: Review/close require incidents.approve; reopen requires incidents.reopen; view uses incidents.viewAny or viewAssigned.
results.site_privacy: Review policy checks incidents.approve plus submitted state but has no approved-Site assertion; show likewise authorizes policy only. Close/reopen/submit call the Site access assertion.
results.direct_object: Close/reopen Site denial is explicit 403; malformed linked-journey provenance may become 404. Review/show approved-Site scope and concealment are not established.
results.states_effects: draft to submitted to reviewed to closed; reopen to reviewed. Review/close/reopen lock the parent row inside three-attempt transactions. Close requires review evidence, no open followups, completed required investigation, and closed linked H&S governance, then writes a durable lifecycle outbox.
results.audit_provenance: Reviewer/closer/reopener actor/time/reason fields and AuditableChanges exist; close/reopen durable lifecycle signal outbox is present; notifications run after transaction.
results.concurrency_idempotency: Locks and state guards prevent competing transitions; submit has same-state retry, but review/close/reopen reject repeat state rather than returning the original result.
gaps: Review/show Site boundary and concealment are not established.
Close/reopen denial is 403 rather than concealed.
Same-result retry and exactly-once notification are not established.
Tests were not executed.

results.canonical_owner: Controlled-drug register facets currently distributed through EmarController
results.actor_action: Read route uses medications.view; register mutation routes use medications.orders.manage; policy names medications.controlled.record but the controller paths do not invoke it; witness requires medications.controlled.witness but Site/assignment/current competency is not checked.
results.site_privacy: List helper may return organization-wide scope for medication operations or broad client roles; record/balance/resolve commands do not use Client policy or the approved-Site medication scope service.
results.direct_object: Direct-object Site semantics and concealment are not established for register movement, balance check, and discrepancy resolution.
results.states_effects: Movement writes an entry and stock; balance check writes entry, stock, open discrepancy, and incident; resolution closes an open/under-review discrepancy and invokes incident integration; destruction is a separate transaction with stock lock and disposal movement.
results.audit_provenance: Entries use AuditableChanges, discrepancy carries provenance and incident linkage, and policy forbids delete, though controller authorization is missing.
results.concurrency_idempotency: Optional UUID is only a seven-day cache response, not a durable unique register key. General movement is nontransactional; balance transaction lacks stock row lock; cache lookup/write brackets effects; resolution and incident integration lack one shared transaction.
strengths: Balance discrepancy provenance and incident linkage.
gaps: Canonical action authority and Site/direct-object boundary are unresolved.
Durable replay, row locking, and atomic movement/stock are not established.
Exact medication identity and witness Site/competency are not established.
No CD-specific Site/concurrency tests were found or run.

results.canonical_owner: PaymentMatchingService plus settlement and allocation-history owners
results.actor_action: History requires finance.bank.view; suggest/confirm/reject require finance.bank.manage. finance.payments.viewAllSites and finance.payments.manageAllSites broaden scope but do not replace the bank action.
results.site_privacy: Stored match Site equals the canonical invoice/bill Site; active Site and actor approved-Site scope are rechecked under lock; list is Site scoped, and global view is still limited to active Sites.
results.direct_object: Inaccessible or mismatched target aborts with concealed 404.
results.states_effects: suggested to confirmed or rejected; confirmed posts a journal, updates invoice/bill, and appends traceable allocation with Site/target/source/journal/bank transaction/actor; rejected appends actor/time/reason audit and may be re-suggested as a versioned record; allocations are append-only.
results.audit_provenance: Confirm uses AuditLogger::logOrFail and append-only allocation provenance; rejection stores immutable actor/time/reason.
results.concurrency_idempotency: Fixed journal sequence then match, bank transaction, and target locks in a three-attempt transaction; already-confirmed returns the same match only when canonical journal/allocation evidence exists; unique settlement source and bank transaction keys prevent duplicate settlement; repeat rejection is state-rejected.
strengths: Action/Site split and concealed foreign targets.
Replay validation, lock ordering, and uniqueness.
gaps: The frozen target combines allocation-history and match-review facets.
Index payload does not expose stored rejection reason/actor/time.
Source does not prove every related-object serialization case.
Tests were not executed.
